Lunch Special (Monday-Friday 11 am- 4pm)
One 12" one topping pizza, two small salads and two drinks for $22.95 only!

notes: The online menu lists the lunch special as Mon-Fri 11 AM - 3 PM at $23.18+ (tax included). The homepage says 11am-4pm for $22.95. These conflict, and the homepage version was used.
